elements.label: Figure 3.18
elements.description: Grouped bar chart of participation in agricultural activities, national level, 2010–2020. Y-axis: "Annual growth (%)", scale 0–60 (ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60); the header reads "Share of households with income source (%)". X-axis categories (left to right): Agricultural land, Agricultural services, Aquaculture, By-products, Forestry, Fruit, Industrial crops, Livestock, Rice, Staples, Total. Each category shows a sequence of colored bars for successive survey years, with x-labels 2012, 2016, 2020 printed under each group. Note: Agricultural land data missing in 2014. Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2010–2020. Approximate readings (~): Agricultural land ~1 to ~3 (2020 ~2); Agricultural services ~2 to ~3, declining slightly; Aquaculture ~15 (2012) falling to ~5 (2020); By-products ~40 (2012) falling to ~19 (2020); Forestry ~15 falling to ~6; Fruit ~29 falling to ~15; Industrial crops ~20 falling to ~8; Livestock ~43 falling to ~30 by 2020; Rice ~43 falling to ~26; Staples ~35 falling to ~19; Total ~64 (2012), ~60 (2014–2016 range), ~48 (2020). Pattern: most sub-sectors show declining shares over the decade, while Livestock and Rice remain the largest of the specific sub-sectors and Total declines from about 64 to about 48.

elements.label: Figure 3.19
elements.description: Small-multiple line chart of share of households (%) participating in agricultural activities by region, 2010–2020, with one panel per sub-sector: Agricultural land, Agricultural services, Aquaculture, By-products, Forestry, Fruit, Industrial crops, Livestock, Rice, Staples, and Any agricultural activity. Y-axis: "Share of households (%)", ticks 0, 20, 40, 60, 80. X-axis years 2010, 2012, ..., 2020 in each panel. Legend series: Central Highlands (teal-green); Mekong Delta (yellow); Midlands & Northern Mountain (orange); Northern & Coastal Central Region (blue); Red River Delta (grey); Southeast (green). Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2010–2020. Approximate readings (~): Any agricultural activity: Midlands & Northern Mountain ~85 (2010) easing to ~78 (2020); Northern & Coastal Central ~75 falling to ~62; Central Highlands ~80 falling to ~70; Red River Delta ~68 falling to ~43; Mekong Delta ~70 falling to ~57; Southeast ~24 falling to ~13. Livestock: Midlands & Northern Mountain ~78 falling to ~70; Central Highlands ~50 to ~40; Northern & Coastal Central ~57 to ~42; Red River Delta ~43 falling to ~24; Mekong Delta ~32 to ~24; Southeast ~12 to ~8. Rice: Midlands & Northern Mountain ~72 falling to ~58; Red River Delta ~57 falling to ~25; Northern & Coastal Central ~55 to ~40; Mekong Delta ~32 falling to ~16; Central Highlands ~29; Southeast ~5 to ~2. By-products: Midlands & Northern Mountain ~62 falling to ~45; Northern & Coastal Central ~50 to ~30; Red River Delta ~45 falling to ~12; Central Highlands ~30 to ~10; Mekong Delta ~35 to ~20; Southeast ~9 to ~6. Staples: Midlands & Northern Mountain ~78 falling to ~63; Red River Delta ~38 falling to ~18; Northern & Coastal Central ~49 falling to ~29; Central Highlands ~48 to ~29; Mekong Delta ~16 falling to ~4; Southeast ~6 to ~5. Aquaculture, Agricultural services, Agricultural land and Industrial crops show mostly low values (below ~40, many below ~10) with Mekong Delta and Central Highlands among the higher series in some panels. Pattern: most regions show declining participation over 2010–2020, with the Midlands & Northern Mountain region highest in most sub-sectors and the Southeast lowest.
